proc main (): eff loaded integer :=
  let strong arr: pointer =
    create(Ivalignof('signed int[3]'), 'signed int[3]') in
  let strong a_509: loaded array(integer) =
    bound(
      let weak (a_512: loaded integer, a_511: loaded integer,
      a_510: loaded integer) =
        unseq(pure(Specified(30)), pure(Specified(20)), pure(Specified(10))) in
      pure(
        Specified(Array(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_510),
        conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_511),
        conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_512)))
      )
    ) in
  store('signed int[3]', arr, a_509) ;
  let strong a_524: loaded integer =
    bound(
      let weak a_523: pointer =
        let weak a_513: loaded pointer =
          let weak (a_516: loaded pointer, a_518: loaded integer) =
            unseq(
              let weak a_521: pointer = pure(arr) in
              pure(Specified(array_shift(a_521, 'signed int', 0)))
            ,
              pure(Specified(1))
            ) in
          case (a_516, a_518) of
            | (Specified(a_517: pointer), Specified(a_519: integer)) =>
                pure(Specified(array_shift(a_517, 'signed int', a_519)))
            | _: (loaded pointer,loaded integer) =>
                pure(undef(<<UB_CERB004_unspecified__pointer_add>>))
          end in
        case a_513 of
          | Specified(a_514: pointer) =>
              let weak a_515: boolean =
                memop(PtrValidForDeref, 'signed int', a_514) in
              pure(
                if a_515 then
                  a_514
                else
                  undef(<<UB043_indirection_invalid_value>>)
              )
          | Unspecified(_: ctype) =>
              pure(undef(<<UB043_indirection_invalid_value>>))
        end in
      load('signed int', a_523)
    ) in
  kill('signed int[3]', arr) ;
  run ret_508(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_524)) ;
  kill('signed int[3]', arr) ;
  pure(Unit) ;
  save ret_508: loaded integer (a_525: loaded integer:= Specified(0)) in
    pure(a_525)
